title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon who has the Izzet League seal a courtyard in the Ninth District around a mysterious door.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild whose researchers study the door under Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild whose guards protect the perimeter and post false necromancy notices.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild whose ward lines seal the courtyard on Niv-Mizzet's behalf.

entities.name: The Ninth District
entities.description: The Ravnican district where the Izzet League has closed a courtyard.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane, shown on a peaceful day before the door.

entities.name: The Door
entities.description: A strange, unlocked door in the Ninth District that leads into the House of Duskmourn and vanishes behind whoever enters.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The nightmarish house beyond the door where most routes end in horrible fates.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon whose face is seen by those who walk into the light at the end of door forty.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Smiling hosts with screaming eyes who keep guests and read them their holy book.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
aliases: figures made of wicker woven with flowers
entities.description: Dancing wicker figures that tire never and take dancers' bodies.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Spindly horrors that unfold from basement shadows and kill quickly.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Hulking, masked hunters in leather aprons who play with their prey, serving a master in white leather.

entities.name: Beastie
entities.description: A masked creature with multicolored striped fur and balloons on its horn that befriends and protects a human.

events.summary: The reader learns Niv-Mizzet has taken over a Ninth District courtyard and had it sealed.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet has been doing something strange in a courtyard in the Ninth District.

events.summary: Boros notices warn of necromantic energy that is not actually present.
events.quote: you see Boros notices, warning of necromantic energy in the area, but you don't detect anything.

events.summary: In one path, the reader launches pigeons from a trebuchet to distract the guards.
events.quote: you purchase a cage of pigeons from a passing vendor and rig a rudimentary trebuchet

events.summary: The reader finds that the focus of the research is just a door.
events.quote: It's a door. Just a door.

events.summary: Several approaches to the guards end with the reader taken into Boros custody.
events.quote: You are taken off to spend the day in Boros custody.

events.summary: On another path, the reader leaves the courtyard and goes to a coffee shop.
events.quote: You turn around and head for your favorite coffee shop, where you place your order.

events.summary: The reader bluffs past guards by pretending to deliver flowers for the Guildpact.
events.quote: Delivery for the Guildpact.

events.summary: The reader tries the door and finds it unlocked.
events.quote: You try the doorknob. It turns easily.

events.summary: The door slams shut and vanishes behind the reader in an impossible hallway.
events.quote: As you step into the hall, the door slams shut behind you.

events.summary: A hallway turns into a glass-walled vast aquarium with captive leviathans.
events.quote: through which you can see what seems to be the interior of a vast aquarium

events.summary: In the library, a chair slowly swallows the reader, who becomes a permanent fixture of Duskmourn.
events.quote: Looking down, you see that the chair has swallowed your legs, and is spreading up your midsection, devouring you by painless inches.

events.summary: The reader dances with wickerfolk until wicker wraps around their bones.
events.quote: By the time you feel the wicker wrapping around your bones, it's far too late.

events.summary: The reader meets a masked, striped, balloon-horned creature on a stream bank.
events.quote: There is a strange creature crouching on the bank, fur striped in many colors, a bunch of balloons tied to one horn.

events.summary: A cellarspawn unfolds from basement shadows and kills the reader.
events.quote: The cellarspawn kill quickly, if not gently.

events.summary: A rope bridge snaps and drops the reader into a rotting bog.
events.quote: The sound of the rope snapping behind you is almost a relief.

events.summary: Smiling hosts in a hillside house read the reader their holy book, and the reader joins the Cult of Valgavoth.
events.quote: You belong to the Cult of Valgavoth now.

events.summary: Razorkin capture the reader in the steam and offer to spare them if they join.
events.quote: The razorkin enjoy playing with their prey, but they will spare you if you join them.

events.summary: A tentacle drags the reader off the room's floor into the water to drown.
events.quote: a vast tentacle whips out of the water and wraps around your waist

events.summary: The reader befriends the masked beastie and lives in a pantry under its protection.
events.quote: your creature, your beastie, chases them away.

events.summary: Following the light to door forty, the reader sees the face of Valgavoth.
events.quote: You have seen the face of Valgavoth.

events.summary: Hands grab the reader from under a catwalk and drop them into burning coals.
events.quote: hands reach up from underneath the catwalk and jerk you over the edge

relations.note: He convinced the Azorius to seal the courtyard on his behalf.
relations.quote: convincing the Azorius to seal it on his behalf

relations.note: A strange door in a sealed courtyard.
relations.quote: The design is wrong for the district, and no one's getting too close, but it's still just a door.

relations.note: Wickerfolk claim dancers for the House.
